items.raw_excerpt: Doctors at Radboudumc have successfully completed clitoral reconstruction surgeries in women who lost part of the sex organ to vulvar cancer, including restoring their ability to orgasm. In a statement, the hospital in Nijmegen said that of 23 women who underwent the procedure, 90% were able to experience a clitoral orgasm again. In the Netherlands, approximately 450 women are diagnosed with vulvar cancer every year. In around 25% of those cases, the clitoris or the surrounding area is affected.
items.summary_en: Doctors in Nijmegen have successfully rebuilt the clitoris for women who lost part of it to vulvar cancer. The hospital said 90 percent of the 23 women treated could reach orgasm again. About 450 women in the Netherlands are diagnosed with vulvar cancer each year.
